overload_stops_rev_j.question: can the 0.2 mm overload-stop gaps be fixed-height (no adjustment)?
overload_stops_rev_j.allowed_band_mm: 0.1..0.3 (above the working deflection, below the cell's safe overload deflection: NOMINAL)
overload_stops_rev_j.answer: no: the stack (worst 0.77, RSS 0.39) is 3-8 x the +/-0.1 band, even with machined spacers
overload_stops_rev_j.replacement: keep the M4 set screw, set it by instrument: screw in until the HX711 reading moves by 1 N (contact), back off two GG-3 notches (120 deg = 0.23 mm on M4 x 0.7), lock the nut, then confirm the reading returns to its zero

br3_y_index_rev_j.effect: nest line within +/-0.2 mm of the nozzle row in Y (the rack pitch tolerance is larger)

LC-4 (method-B eject).path: EJ-1 finger -> 2 x M3 -> BR-6 carrier (in a BR-2 window) -> lug -> 2 x M4 -> LC-4 bar free end -> bar -> fixed end -> 2 x M4 -> BR-7 -> 2 x M4 -> BR-2
LC-4 (method-B eject).stall_case: an upward Z stall at the eject top (head report z_screw_axial_support_rev_g4: about 754 N at 1.3 A) ends on the overload screw, not the cell

LC-1 (pick-up).path: tips -> rack -> IN-P -> BR-4 -> 2 x M6 -> LC-1 free end -> fixed end -> 2 x M6 -> BR-3
LC-1 (pick-up).stall_case: a downward Z stall onto the rack (about 767 N at 1.3 A) ends on the BR-9 stop

LC-2 (strip).path: tips -> TW-4D comb -> TW-1 -> BR-5 -> 2 x M6 -> LC-2 free end -> fixed end -> 2 x M6 -> BR-3
LC-2 (strip).stall_case: an upward Z stall with tips caught under the comb ends on the BR-9 stop

LC-3 (plunger).path: LGA35 actuator rod (V6; was NEMA11) -> HP-5R yoke -> LC-3 button cell (in the yoke pocket, M3 into its back) -> pipette plunger button
LC-3 (plunger).overload: no mechanical stop: the LGA35 at 0.7 A (about 140 N at 2 mm/s, INFERENCE) stays inside the 200 N rating; CT-0d (ADR-014) needs the 120 N pass on this cell: 60 % of its range (integration 23 Nov 2026: was a 100 N cell, which could not show 120 N); for CT-0d a die spring (about 12.5 N/mm) goes in series between the actuator rod and the yoke

BR-3.why: G2 model 475 x 180 was too short for the plate-nest insert at x 320 (insert to x 385, BR-3 to 355) and the parts-list text 760 x 250 was stale (G1): G3 moves the plate nest to x 290 and the balance to x 480 (clear of BR-3 by 10 mm), keeps the rack at 0 and the comb nest at 151; BR-3 = x -85..360, 87.5 in front of (feet clear of the windows) and 172.5 behind the nest line (load-cell fixed ends)
BR-3.y_setting: BR-3 stands on its four feet and is slid in Y so the nest line sits under the mounted pipette's nozzle row: rig y pipette_small -80.0, pipette_8ch_50 -100.0, pipette_8ch_300 -102.5 (no Y axis)

tests.FIRST - CT-0a latch release force: the rig carriage with the LTG-1 latch, a tool latched on a seated two-bay dock; the dock lift pushes the roller through the 500 N button cell under the pad: log force vs bar stroke; pass: peak <= lift thrust / 1.5 and within 20 % of the calculated profile (head report coupling.latch.table)
tests.FIRST - CT-0b re-latch force and preload: bar lowered slowly with the stud seated: the springs must close the toggle 100 of 100 times with 0.67 x spring force (a third of the springs' force taken off by a hanging weight); preload measured with PLF-L and the S-cell (separation at the tool plate edge) for each of 6 knobs: pass >= 520 N
tests.FIRST - CT-1 repeatability, 1,000 exchan: two indicators (X, Y) on magnetic bases touch the ground D6 pin held on the nozzle (NRP-L); exchange tool in/out of the two-bay dock with the dock lift; pass <= 0.10 mm 3 sigma at the nozzle
tests.FIRST - CT-0c comb entry with real tips: one TPK-S group (S E S) cut for the rig M300's measured nozzle row: 500 park/re-pick cycles of real p300 tips in random order: no strike, no collar left out of its pocket, no tip left on a strip
tests.FIRST - CT-0d pusher force at 0.7 A: LGA35 at 0.7 A, 24 V, 2 / 5 / 8 mm/s against the 200 N button cell with the die spring in series in the pusher line: pass >= 120 N at 5 mm/s (80 N x 1.5) without lost steps; also log the homing stall current (<= 0.57 A)
tests.CT-2 added deflection at 120 / 150 N: LJF-L pushes the nozzle pin sideways through the 500 N S-cell; pass <= 0.05 mm
tests.CT-3 no lift-off at 2 x the working forc: PLF-L pulls the tool plate down through the S-cell to 2 x eject/strip force; separation < 0.005 mm
tests.CT-4 power-off pull and half-locks: motor power off, pull at 2 x; shim under one ball, wrong bay, debris, a constant-force spring removed: the latch must never read LOCKED with a bad seat it can detect (latch.SENSE: stud 0.12 mm or more off), and the tool never drops; record which shims read CLOSED-EMPTY / NOT CLOSED
tests.CT-SYR syringe return spring: 10 mL syringe with the 1.5 x 20 x 75 return spring: plunger seal friction (pull-out force at 1 mm/s, wet), the plunger follows the pusher up 100 of 100 refills at 5 mm/s; pass: spring force out / measured friction + valve >= 1.5
tests.CT-5 3,000 exchanges: automatic cycling between the two bays with the dock lift; no undetected failure, <= 1 detected per 1,000
tests.CT-6 pipetting after exchange: gravimetric, S10 and M300, against the same pipette bolted directly
tests.CT-7 force switch through the push-rod: load cell under the nozzle: trip within 15 % of the cradle's set force
tests.CT-8 tool code: Hall switches against 1,000 insertions: no misread
tests.CT-9 real forces: eight-tip pick-up, comb strip, ejector, 1,000 uL plunger

wiring.summary_rev_j: Z-up switch: normally-open (made at the top).  Cradle force switch: normally-closed.  Load cells: read by the head board (MMB CAN, Klipper [load_cell] through the HX711s), not by the Pi.

inputs.Z up: D2F roller lever, normally-open, wired NO: CLOSED from the normal top up to the eject top (bench_rig.cfg '^!'); a broken wire reads 'not up' and blocks X moves (fail-safe; rev G5 correction: was 'NC')
inputs.tip force: cradle force switch, normally-closed: D2F changeover on the cradle body (CB-1; HP-1 before rev J) wired NC: a broken wire reads 'force reached' and ends the stroke (rev G5 correction: was 'NO')

wiring.load_cells: LC-1 (rack), LC-2 (comb), LC-3 (plunger yoke), LC-4 (eject): one HX711 each on the BR-8 plate, read by the head board (MMB CAN) through Klipper [load_cell] (rev G5 correction: not the Pi GPIO)
wiring.balance: RS232/USB to the Pi; stable-reading command per weighing; draft shield top door left open only for the nozzle
wiring.power: 24 V PSU -> MMB; Pi on its own 5 V supply; E-stop in the 24 V motor line

bead_retention_fixture.measure: bead and DNA recovery per transfer against the hand method (first biological test, ADR-006)

tipless_prototype (concept only).bulk_dispense_nozzle: an 8-nozzle non-contact head (PA12 manifold, 0.5 mm stainless needles at 9 mm pitch) on the PA-1 module adapter pattern on TP-1; small pump and reagent bottle on BR-8; dispense over the balance

procedures.plunger: step the plunger at 0.1 mm, log LC-3 force and step count to first and second stop, per pipette
procedures.gravimetric: dispense 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 50, 300 uL into the trap vial on the balance, 20-100 replicates each, ISO 8655-6 corrections (Z factor, evaporation blank); dial at the build's fixed setting and at the volume, to test M11
procedures.pickup_strip: pick one and eight tips over LC-1 with the force switch ending the stroke; strip on TW-4D over LC-2; log peak forces
procedures.hard_stop: per cradle (BR-B11): stop screw fully down; jog with a 0.5 mm feeler on the rack until pinched -> s_pinch; contact s_c = s_pinch + 0.5; jog to s_c - set gap (3.0 rig / 3.5 machine), raise the stop screw to the ledge, lock the nut; verify >= 2 mm gap with the axis on the stop; firmware limit = stop - 1
